title: Groove and Cam
subtitle: The fifth and seventh Degrees
text: At the fifth Degree the Artificer gives the Precision Governor Kit. Offer it during the Rite of the True Groove and feed two marked points with 250 mL each; the upgraded forge can record one enchantment or Scriptorium curse at a time. At the seventh Degree, the Master Cam Kit and Rite of the Enduring Pattern open three 250 mL points. The finished forge can stabilize a recorded cylinder for repeated use. Interrupted rites return their held work through the Cardinal recovery system.
